data.name: Dawoodi
data.gender_notes: Dawoodi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name that symbolizes love and loyalty, often associated with the prophet David in Islamic tradition. The name Dawoodi carries the meaning “Loving and faithful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dawoodi usually hope their child will grow to embody loving and faithful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Compassionate and devoted, reflecting the qualities of the prophet David (AS)
data.etymology: Dawoodi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Loving and faithful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dawoodi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: داودي
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من داود عليه السلام، يعني محب داود
in_arabic.long_meaning: داودي اسم يدل على الاشتقاق من النبي داود عليه السلام، ويعني الشخص الذي يحب داود أو يتبعه، ويرتبط هذا الاسم بالعائلة النبوية المكرمة.

in_urdu.name: داؤدی
in_urdu.meaning: داؤد علیہ السلام کا خاندان، داؤد کا پیروکار
in_urdu.long_meaning: داؤدی نام داؤد علیہ السلام کے خاندان اور ان کی پیروی کرنے والوں کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے، جو اسلامی تاریخ میں ایک اہم مقام رکھتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: दावूदी
in_hindi.meaning: दाऊद का वंशज, दाऊद का अनुयायी
in_hindi.long_meaning: दावूदी नाम का अर्थ है दाऊद नबी के वंशज या उनके अनुयायी, जो हज़रात दाऊद के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है और उनकी विरासत को आगे बढ़ाता है.

in_pashto.name: داودي
in_pashto.meaning: د داود کورنۍ، د داود پلوی
in_pashto.long_meaning: داودي نوم د داود نبي د کورنۍ او د هغه د پلویانو لپاره کارول کېږي، چې د افغانستان او نورو پښتوخېلو سیمو کې د احترام وړ نوم دی.

in_english.name: Dawoodi
in_english.meaning: Descendant or follower of Prophet Dawood (David)
in_english.long_meaning: The name Dawoodi signifies a connection to Prophet Dawood (David), denoting either a descendant or a follower of the Prophet. It carries a rich history within Islamic tradition, referencing the esteemed lineage and teachings of Dawood.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Dawoodi" is derived from the Arabic word "Dawood," which is believed to have been the name of the prophet David in the Islamic tradition. Prophet David is considered to be one of the major prophets in Islam who played a significant role in establishing the law and worship in the children of Israel.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Dawoodi" has a profound spiritual significance for Muslims, particularly those who identify with this particular sect.
